title: PR #202: audit: reconcile delivery registry against current repository census
content:
State: closed
Merged: True
Draft: False

## Purpose
Publish the SHA-bound delivery-registry reconciliation for review and enforce machine-readable validation.

## Evidence baseline
- Working branch: `audit/reconcile-delivery-registry-2026-10-11`
- Current exact head: `4b6f95cb99740e14c813bca6a5f8520a083de9a8`
- Registry covers the 33-repository census (26 active, 7 archived), with per-repository delivery plans and explicit residuals.
- Formal JSON Schema: `control-plane/DELIVERY_REGISTRY.schema.json` (Draft 2020-12).
- Fail-closed semantic validator: `tools/validate_delivery_registry.py`.
- Dedicated CI: `.github/workflows/delivery-registry-validation.yml` with negative self-tests.

## Review gates
- Require terminal schema + semantic validator results at the exact PR head.
- Confirm current HEAD/tree evidence and audit timestamps are internally consistent.
- Review repository roles and migration/SSOT residuals; README text alone is not source-coverage evidence.
- Keep all unverified workstreams `RESIDUAL` or `BLOCKED`; do not mark `VERIFIED` without exact-SHA Run/Job/Step evidence.

## Safety
Draft until CI and independent review pass. No auto-merge, no force-push, no weakened checks, no source migration or archival authorized by this PR.
